newsitem.title: USA: CNS, Healthdyne in distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: CNS, Healthdyne in distribution pact.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc will be the exclusive distributor in the U.S. and Canadian professional medical markets for Breathe Right nasal strips made by CNS Inc, the companies jointly announced.
The Breathe Right is an adhesive strip that stretches across the nose to open nasal passages and improve breathing.

Marietta, Ga.-based Healthdyne will market the product to the home health care market, hospitals, nursing homes and other alternate care sites under a multi-year agreement, subject to performance requirements, the companies said.
Minneapolis-based CNS said it will develop packaging to meet the needs of the professional medical market.
Healthdyne designs, manufactures and markets medical devices for use in the home, as well as other specialized clinical settings.
Shares in CNS were up 3/4 to 16-3/8. Healthdyne shares were unchanged at 8-7/8.
